newsitem.title: POLAND: Zasada owes Mercedes PLN 133 mln.
newsitem.headline: Zasada owes Mercedes PLN 133 mln.

text.p: Polish automotive company Sobieslaw Zasada Centrum SA said in statement on Monday that debts owed to Mercedes Benz AG at the end of March amounted to 132.7 million zlotys of which 73.4 million was long-term.
It gave no further details and company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Zasada is Mercedes-Benz's fficial distrubutor and assembler in Poland.
